LanguageData.InspiredPassionsSettings_passionInspirat: Inspiration can grant a new passion
Pawns with few passions can get an inspiration that gives them a new passion or upgrades a minor passion to major. Default: ON.
LanguageData.InspiredPassionsSettings_passionMetalBre: Mental break can remove a passion
Pawns with many passions can have a mental break that removes a passion or downgrades a major passion to minor. Default: ON.
LanguageData.InspiredPassionsSettings_passionMaxCount: A pawn with this many passions or more will not get this inspiration. Major passions count as one passion, same as minor passions. Also scales how likely the passion mental break is. Default: 9.
LanguageData.InspiredPassionsSettings_upgradeExisting: Minor passions can be upgraded to major
If turned off, only skills without passions can gain a passion. Note: a pawn must have at least two such skills. Default: ON.
LanguageData.InspiredPassionsSettings_traitInspiratio: Inspiration can give a new trait or remove a bad trait

A pawn with few traits or with a bad trait can get an inspiration that gives them an additional trait or removes a bad trait. The new trait will mostly be a good trait (only upsides), but sometimes the inspiration can also grant or remove a neutral trait (both upsides and downsides). A trait like Pyromaniac is neutral, as it gives a mood boost along with fire-starting sprees. Default: ON.
LanguageData.InspiredPassionsSettings_traitMetalBreak: Mental break can give a new bad trait or remove a good trait

A pawn with good traits or room for more traits can have a mental break that removes a good trait or gives a bad trait. The removed trait will mostly be a good trait (only upsides), but sometimes the mental break can also remove or give a neutral trait (both upsides and downsides). A trait like Neurotic is neutral, as it gives a work speed bonus but also makes mental breaks more likely. Default: ON.
LanguageData.InspiredPassionsSettings_traitInspiratio: 0 means neutral traits are never considered, 1 means they have the same weight as good and bad traits. Affects both inspirations and mental breaks. A trait like Brawler is neutral, as it gives a melee boost but a shooting penalty. Default: 0.5.
LanguageData.InspiredPassionsSettings_traitMaxCount_t: Pawns will not get new traits above this count. Applies to traits from both inspirations and mental breaks. Default: 3.
LanguageData.InspiredPassionsSettings_eventsGiveThoug: Pawns get thoughts about gained or lost traits and passions
Gaining or losing a trait or passion gives the pawn a related thought. Default: ON.
LanguageData.InspiredPassionsSettings_affects_guests_: Inspirations and mental breaks will also affect guests and visitors. Default: OFF.
LanguageData.InspiredPassionsSettings_affects_prisone: Inspirations and mental breaks will also affect prisoners. Default: ON.
LanguageData.InspiredPassionsSettings_affects_slaves_: Inspirations and mental breaks will also affect slaves. Default: ON.
